# Load Required Libraries
library(dplyr)

library(ggplot2)

# Set seed for exact reproducibility

# Section 5: Clustering Analysis (RQ3 / RO3)

```{r clustering-analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# 1.1 Load Movie Data
movies <- read_csv("movies.csv")

# 1.2 Text Preprocessing Pipeline
corpus <- Corpus(VectorSource(movies$overview))
corpus <- tm_map(corpus, content_transformer(tolower))
corpus <- tm_map(corpus, removePunctuation)
corpus <- tm_map(corpus, removeNumbers)
corpus <- tm_map(corpus, removeWords, stopwords("en"))

# Remove domain-specific filler terms
domain_stopwords <- c("film", "story", "life", "finds", "takes", "one", "two", "new")
corpus <- tm_map(corpus, removeWords, domain_stopwords)
corpus <- tm_map(corpus, stripWhitespace)

# 1.3 Construct TF-IDF Weighted Document-Term Matrix
dtm_tfidf <- DocumentTermMatrix(corpus, control = list(weighting = weightTfIdf))
dtm_tfidf_sparse <- removeSparseTerms(dtm_tfidf, 0.98)
tfidf_matrix <- as.matrix(dtm_tfidf_sparse)

# 1.4 L2-Normalization
# Ensures Euclidean distance maps to cosine distance for Ward.D2
tfidf_norm <- t(apply(tfidf_matrix, 1, function(x) {
  norm <- sqrt(sum(x^2))
  if (norm == 0) return(x) else return(x / norm)
}))

# 1.5 Calculate Distance and Hierarchical Clustering
norm_dist <- dist(tfidf_norm, method = "euclidean")
hclust_ward <- hclust(norm_dist, method = "ward.D2")

# 1.6 Cut Tree into 4 Clusters
clusters <- cutree(hclust_ward, k = 4)
movies$cluster <- as.factor(clusters)

cat("\nCluster Size Breakdown:\n")
print(table(movies$cluster))

# 1.7 Cluster Visualisation (PCA projection)
pca_res <- prcomp(tfidf_norm)
pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_res$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_res$x[, 2],
  Cluster = movies$cluster
)

p_cluster <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "t", level = 0.95, linetype = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Movie Narrative Clusters (PCA 2D Projection)",
    x = "Dim 1",
    y = "Dim 2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p_cluster)


# ggsave("cluster_visualization.png", plot = p_cluster, width = 8, height = 6)
```

# Section 6: Network Analysis (RQ4 / RO4)

```{r network-analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# 2.1 Load Cast Data
cast <- read_csv("cast.csv")

# 2.2 Bipartite Projection (Actor-Movie -> Actor-Actor Adjacency Matrix)
actor_movie_pairs <- cast %>% select(actor_name, movie_id)
actor_matrix <- table(actor_movie_pairs$actor_name, actor_movie_pairs$movie_id)
actor_adj_matrix <- actor_matrix %*% t(actor_matrix)
diag(actor_adj_matrix) <- 0  # Remove self-loops

# 2.3 Construct Undirected Weighted Network Graph
g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
  actor_adj_matrix,
  mode = "undirected",
  weighted = TRUE
)

# 2.4 Calculate Global Topological Metrics
num_nodes <- vcount(g)
num_edges <- ecount(g)
net_density <- edge_density(g)
num_components <- count_components(g)

# 2.5 Extract Giant Component
components_info <- components(g)
giant_nodes <- V(g)[components_info$membership == which.max(components_info$csize)]
g_giant <- induced_subgraph(g, giant_nodes)

# 2.6 Filter Subgraph (Giant Component & Degree >= 5)
subgraph_nodes <- V(g_giant)[degree(g_giant) >= 5]
g_sub <- induced_subgraph(g_giant, subgraph_nodes)

# 2.7 Output Topological Properties
cat("\n--- Full Network Topology ---\n")
cat("Total Nodes (V):", num_nodes, "\n")
cat("Total Edges (E):", num_edges, "\n")
cat("Network Density:", round(net_density, 6), "\n")
cat("Connected Components:", num_components, "\n")
cat(
  "Giant Component Size:", vcount(g_giant), "(",
  round(vcount(g_giant) / num_nodes * 100, 2), "% )\n"
)

cat("\n--- Filtered Subgraph Metrics (Giant Comp & Degree >= 5) ---\n")
cat("Subgraph Nodes:", vcount(g_sub), "\n")
cat("Subgraph Edges:", ecount(g_sub), "\n")

# 2.8 Compute Centrality Measures
degree_val <- degree(g)
betweenness_val <- betweenness(g, normalized = TRUE)

actor_metrics <- data.frame(
  Actor = names(degree_val),
  Degree = degree_val,
  Betweenness = betweenness_val
)

cat("\nTop 10 Actors by Degree Centrality:\n")
print(head(actor_metrics %>% arrange(desc(Degree)), 10))

cat("\nTop 10 Actors by Betweenness Centrality:\n")
print(head(actor_metrics %>% arrange(desc(Betweenness)), 10))

# 2.9 Subgraph Visualization (Fruchterman-Reingold Layout)
p_net <- ggraph(g_sub, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(aes(width = weight), alpha = 0.2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_node_point(aes(size = degree(g_sub)), color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(degree(g_sub) >= 25, name, "")),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8)) +
  labs(
    title = "Actor Collaboration Subgraph (Giant Component, Degree >= 5)",
    size = "Degree"
  ) +
  theme_void()

print(p_net)

# ggsave("network_subgraph_visualization.png", plot = p_net, width = 10, height = 8)
```
